title: AE Spotlight
description: Person-led ad that introduces one Account Executive (or any team member) to local dental practices by first name, with three benefits and a demo CTA.
useWhen: A person is the message: an AE, a speaker or a team member introduced by first name, with a demo or meeting CTA.
notWhen: The ad sells a product claim, or announces an event booth.
guidance: ae-first-name: first name followed by a period ("Sarah."). "Meet" is fixed and scales with the name.
ae-name and ae-title share the name plate: if the name needs two lines, keep the title to one line.
ae-location: city and state ("Austin, TX"); set uppercase by the design. Pass null to remove the pill when there is no city.
ae: the person's real photo as a cutout (transparent PNG), head and shoulders. Never generate or substitute another person's photo.
